summary: The ChangePasswordNoMaster functionality allows authenticated users to change their password without involving a master account. The process is enforced through a secure web form with robust password validation and explicit consent to privacy policies.
purpose: To provide users (students, instructors, staff, etc.) a secure, self-service method to change their passwords, while enforcing strong password complexity and ensuring acknowledgment of organizational policies.

fields.name: txtNewPassword
validations: Must contain upper and lower case letters
Must contain at least one symbol
Must be different from current password

fields.name: chkPolicy
fields.description: Confirmation of reading and agreeing to User Responsibilities/Policies

workflows.name: Change Password Without Master
steps: System validates URL hash for session security.
User is presented with fields for current password, new password, repeat new password, and policy checkbox.
User enters current password, new password, and confirms new password.
System validates all fields and displays validation summary if errors exist.
If validation passes, Security.ChangePassword is called.
If password is successfully changed, UserSession sets a success message.
System redirects user based on role (Student, Instructor, StaffAdmin, DC, Supervisor, or default Tools page).
If validation fails or change unsuccessful, appropriate error messages are displayed.

business_rules: New password must not be same as current password.
User must acknowledge reading and agreeing to organizational policies.
Password should follow complexity: minimum 12 characters, contains digits, upper and lower case, symbol.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for current password and new password.
CompareValidator to ensure new passwords match and are not same as current.
Client-side validation function for policy acknowledgement (ValidatePolicy).
conditions: If Request.QueryString contains Student, Instructor, StaffAdmin, DC, or Supervisor, redirect accordingly after change.
If not, redirect to Tools page.
system_behavior: On Page_Load, system sets up the page, registers JavaScript, and initializes labels.
On password change attempt, system validates input, applies business rules, and handles errors/messages.
Panel controls for displaying errors and warnings.
PasswordStrength indicator appears for new password input.
ValidationSummary aggregates and displays validation messages.
exceptions: User fails to agree to policies.
New password fails any complexity validation.
content_gaps: Some referenced resource strings (e.g., Resources:Resources, Resources:again) are not included in the documents and may be needed for final UI text.
Details of Security.ChangePassword implementation and Help policy text retrieval are abstracted and not described in available material.
